visualCharacteristics.purpose: Residency status panel explaining domestic vs international applicability

contentPattern.structure: One row per panel section (separated by rules). First section: a short title line (optional :icon: + e.g. 'Domestic student'), an optional one-link paragraph ('Change') shown inline, then explanatory text. Optional audience-keyed rows: cell 1 = audience key (domestic / international), cell 2 = content; only the section matching the audience-switcher selection is shown.
